author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear looks at the new Aston Martin Dreadnought. A collab between Aston Martin’s design department and the developers of the new Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 game, it’s a massive, military-grade and V12-powered supertruck that takes the DNA from the likes of the Victor, Valour, Vulcan and Valkyrie and injects it into a combat-ready off-roader.
